status: Frozen asphalt-A baseline; effective linear-model parameters, not a universal-surface calibration
fit_objective: Equal-weight yaw and CoG lateral-velocity squared errors normalized by training-file standard deviations

operating_domain.source: Scored samples in nine asphalt-A training files; 20 ms segmented reader
operating_domain.interpretation: Per-signal ranges only; joint coverage and accuracy are not guaranteed

external_surface_evaluation.unvalidated_conditions: Other vehicles, speeds, loads and road surfaces beyond the listed files
external_surface_evaluation.result: Fitted stiffness beats A-Speed yaw RMSE on four external files; supplied stiffness beats fitted stiffness on both signals in asphalt B, cobble, and asphalt B-cobble files
